scope: H16 local committed close-intent staging/recovery, service hooks, bounded claim selector and explicit storage intent/native-predecessor branches only
static_assessment: Normal execute retains the original source through the final provider guard. The new hook stages intent only after the durable outcome path; claim-only recovery separately represents LOCAL_COMMITTED_CLOSE_INTENT and does not assert that POST occurred.

The stage requires the exact current original positive E5 source hash and approved plan hash, exact stored action/request reconstruction at original request time, one real owned entry request/claim, and the complete canonical graph. It adds only the original durable ORDER_REQUEST when absent; it manufactures no acknowledgment or fill.

Claim clock, local interpretation time and original broker observation clock remain distinct. The storage writer binds the immutable key to the actual claim dispatched_at, validates action/source/entry lineage and unchanged broker facts, and permits only EXIT_REQUESTED projection plus its execution binding; no RAW_POSITION is fabricated.

The bounded own-run pending selector excludes every close claim already having any position bundle, so recovery cannot retrospectively insert an intent before an existing native residual/flat publication. Draining the durable bundle before staging and after every commit preserves idempotent successor-lease replay.

The final dispatch transaction rechecks the claim generation. Native residual/flat observations following an intent must name the exact intent projection predecessor, retain the original source, and preserve their real observation timestamps. Same-clock key conflict is refused rather than repaired with an invented timestamp.

Source tests cover actual scripted acknowledgment/ambiguous paths, unclaimed refusal, claim-only recovery after action expiry without HTTP or fabricated reply, outbox replay with a successor lease, claim-clock mutation, second-connection writer drift and same-clock observation refusal. These are source component fixtures.
limits: Static source reads and raw-byte hashes only; no test/native/product execution, Git changes, DB/auth/config/provider/network access or tracked writes.
Root-reported development passes and the active eight-intent/nine-projection run are not reviewer execution or final qualification results.
A local durable claim/intent is not proof of provider submission, acknowledgment, fill or financial permission. Recovery does not issue a new permit or renew permission.
Funding, protection-stop cleanup, TradeResult/CLOSED, full H16 and installed-native/whole-product qualification remain outside this slice.
